dct_description_sm: Original site: https://fieldmaps.io/data/adm0 International boundaries in two versions using US DoS LSIB for boundaries and OpenStreetMap for coastline data. International: Balanced world view for use by international non-governmental organizations. Disputed areas follow recommended representation used by the UN Clear Map. UN agencies should use official layers at the UN Geospatial Hub. All: Conservative world view that dissagregates all disputed areas. Useful if applying customized area aggregations.
dct_publisher_sm: FieldMaps, U.S. Department of State, OpenStreetMap
